title: Flutter & Dart Mobile Development
description: Build cross-platform iOS and Android apps from one codebase: sound null-safe Dart, widget trees, responsive layouts, state management, navigation, REST APIs, and local storage.
outcomes: Write clean, null-safe Dart with async/await, Futures, and immutable models
Compose responsive Material 3 interfaces with StatelessWidget and StatefulWidget
Fetch JSON from REST APIs, handle loading/error states, and persist data locally
Structure multi-screen navigation and ship release builds for Android and iOS
